title: Fitmates: Group Hikes & Sports
ios_promotional_text: Every weekend, group hikes from Paris you can reach by train. Join an outing, chat with the group and find sport buddies at your level, wherever you are.
play_short_description: Join group hikes, runs and padel games nearby. Find sport buddies, make friends.
description:
Fitmates is the app for doing sports together: group hikes, running, trail, padel, cycling, climbing and more. Find an outing near you, join the group and go with people who want to move, just like you.

No more "we should go one day". With Fitmates, you go on Sunday.

GROUP HIKING AT THE HEART OF FITMATES
Today, the most active Fitmates community is hikers around Paris (Île-de-France): Fontainebleau forest, Chevreuse valley, Vexin, Rambouillet forest… Group hikes every weekend, often starting from a train station so you can come without a car. Easy walk or sporty outing, you'll find a group at your pace.

FIND SPORT BUDDIES
Running alone? Missing a fourth player for padel? Want to hike but nobody is free? Fitmates connects you with sport partners nearby: run clubs, running, trail, walking, cycling, climbing, padel and many other activities.

WHAT YOU CAN DO WITH FITMATES
• Find sports outings and hikes near you, sorted by date, distance and organiser
• Join an outing in one tap and see who's coming
• Chat with the group of each outing: meeting point, train, car sharing, gear
• Create your own outing in one sentence: type "Sunday 10am, 15 km loop from the station, intermediate level", AI fills in the details, you confirm
• Follow your partners and meet again the people you enjoyed going out with
• Get notified when a new outing matches you

MAKE FRIENDS THROUGH SPORT
New in town, want to meet people, break the routine? Group sport is the easiest way to make friends. On Fitmates, you meet for a hike, a run or a padel game, and come back next week with the same people. A real community, in real life.

FOR ORGANISERS
Already running a run club, a hiking group, an association or coaching sessions? Publish your outings on Fitmates, manage sign-ups and talk with participants in one place, without an overflowing WhatsApp group.

FREE TO DOWNLOAD
The Fitmates app is free. Some outings are paid if the organiser decides so (guiding, transport, court rental…): the price is always shown on the outing before you sign up.

WORLDWIDE
Fitmates is open to everyone, everywhere. No outing near you yet? Create the first one and start your community: hiking, running, padel, trail or any sport you enjoy with others.

Download Fitmates, join your first outing this weekend and become a Fitmate.
More info: fitmates.net
